claim_boundary: Browse luminance index 0–100 from the official georeferenced ASF LATLON PNG, same track and frame. Not calibrated γ⁰. Not a measured freeze lag. Not an interferometric displacement.

detector.rule: A patch is a 4-connected group of valid cells at least z standard deviations from the tile-mean browse change, with at least min_cells.

sites.name: Eight Mile Lake
sites.hypothesis: Autumn darkening is the surface pattern L-band freeze/thaw studies watch for. Four browse dates cannot measure how many days freeze was late.

sites.name: Manchac wetlands
sites.hypothesis: Swamp and open water between Lakes Maurepas and Pontchartrain. A brighter or darker browse can come from inundation, wind roughening, or vegetation. This is not a flood-extent map.

sites.name: San Joaquin fields
sites.hypothesis: Irrigated farmland. Browse change can come from harvest, irrigation, or tillage. This is not a crop-type map.

sites.name: Mekong delta
sites.hypothesis: River delta. Browse change can come from rice flooding, harvest, or river stage. This is not a certified inundation product.

sites.name: Hubbard Glacier
sites.hypothesis: Tidewater glacier at the head of Yakutat Bay. Browse change can come from ice, mélange, or moraine roughness. This pair is not a velocity or mass-loss measurement.
